Legion UI Test Report — US-44-45-46: Keyword Matching: Case-Sensitive, Word-Boundary, Negative Suppression

Server: http://127.0.0.1:5095  |  Generated: 2026-03-25 13:13:35
US-44: Global-positive keywords are case-sensitive — "SUCCEED" matches "SUCCEED" but not "succeed". US-45: Keywords stored with leading/trailing spaces use word-boundary regex (?<!\w)KEYWORD(?!\w) — " PUT " matches "HTTP PUT is allowed" but not "PUTTY OUTPUT". US-46: Negative patterns are checked FIRST in _getMatches(); if any negative matches, no positives fire — "NOT vulnerable" suppresses "vulnerable" on the same line. All six scenarios verified via API has_match field AND Selenium proc-match CSS class on the process table row.
